about_the_game:
🐸 Runner Frog

Runner Frog is a fast-paced 2D platformer with a speedrun twist.
Take control of a determined frog and dash through dangerous levels full of traps, platforms, and apples to collect. The goal is simple but addictive: finish each stage as fast as possible, with the fewest deaths, and the most apples gathered.

With precise controls and handcrafted challenges, Runner Frog offers the perfect mix of speed, difficulty, and replayability. Every death is just another chance to improve your run!

🎮 Game Features

  • 50 handcrafted levels, each with unique challenges.

  • Speedrun-focused gameplay: master stages and aim for faster times.

  • Scoring system based on three factors: time, deaths, and apples collected.

  • Tight and responsive controls designed for precision platforming.

  • Retro pixel art style, colorful and nostalgic visuals.

  • Increasing difficulty that tests your skill with every new stage.

🏆 What You Get

When you purchase Runner Frog, you receive the full game with:

  • All 50 playable levels.

  • Built-in speedrun challenges for every stage.

  • An apple collection system to maximize your score.

  • High replay value for those chasing the perfect run.
